title: Shifted Edge and Step Codes
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over bits, let $x$ be a bit string, and let $s,u,v$ be natural numbers. There is an edge from vertex $u+2$ to vertex $v+2$ at radius $s$ exactly when the configuration code $u$ can take one machine step to configuration code $v$, with both configurations using radius $s$.
hypotheses_covered: $N$ is a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over bits
